# AutoAnts

> AutoAnts (the name is short for "automated assistants") is the AI services wing of Blundell Core Holdings, founded and
> run by Lane Davis in Louisiana. It builds websites,
> after-hours lead-intake systems, and AI-search visibility for Louisiana
> service businesses — tree services, pressure washing, concrete, and other
> trades. The first deliverable is always free: AutoAnts builds a working
> preview website for a business before any money changes hands.

## What AutoAnts does
- Builds fast, mobile-first websites for local service businesses, with
  instant-quote forms and click-to-call (free preview built first; $500 one time
  to go live on the client's own domain with the quote form wired to
  their phone)
- Google Business Profile cleanup so the business appears correctly in
  Google and in AI-assistant answers
- After-hours lead intake: every inquiry captured and texted to the owner
  the moment it arrives — nights, weekends, and storm weeks
- AI-search visibility (GEO) for local businesses: measuring whether
  ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity recommend a business, then fixing the
  legitimate signals those answers draw on
- Site Care: $99/month keeps the site, listings, and content current
- The Office Manager: $500/month (founding rate) adds missed-call
  text-back, speed-to-lead, booking and quote follow-up, and review requests

## How it works
1. AutoAnts builds a free one-page preview site for a business, using its
   real reviews, license numbers, and (with permission) its own branding
2. If the owner wants it live: $500 one time covers their domain, a
   working quote form that texts them every lead, and Google Business
   Profile cleanup. Guarantee: live within 7 days of the go-ahead, or the
   setup fee comes back
3. No contract to start; monthly plans cancel anytime after 90 days

## Who it's for
- Home services and trades (tree, HVAC, roofing, plumbing, landscaping): the core focus
- Also offered to auto repair and tire shops, salons and nail spas, and gyms and fitness studios
- Dental and medical offices: not yet; patient information needs a HIPAA program first
- Details: https://autoants.com/who-we-help.html

## Why customers choose it
- Owner-run: owners deal with Lane directly, not a call center; the
  business is built on doing only what it would put its name on
- The free-first model: see the finished work before paying anything
- Flat, quoted-up-front pricing
- Legitimate-only optimization policy: no paid link placements, no seeded
  or undisclosed mentions, no astroturfing — the fixes are real signals
  (complete profiles, real reviews, consistent listings, structured data)

## Related
- Sibling company under Blundell Core Holdings: Streetcar Notary
  (https://streetcarnotary.com), a mobile and online notary service in
  New Orleans run by the same owner
